thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Error ratio ~18% over last 2m. Paging @eric_oncall. Service impact: request failures and increased latency.

eric_oncall: Acked, on it. Pulling logs + checking recent deploys.

alex_sre: Seeing spikes correlated with a routing change at 12:22 UTC. Errors look like backend timeout (504) and some grpc stream resets.

eric_oncall: Thanks. Can you confirm whether dedicated pools were hit? If so, fallback to general pool?

alex_sre: Dedicated pool for model-redwood-7b had tail queues, yes. Initiating reroute to shared pool and increasing qps throttles.

maya_support: I'll draft the initial statuspage copy. Quick ask — approximate customer impact count? even ballpark.

ops-scribe: From logs so far ~1200 failed requests in the window, touching ~40 unique customer API keys, mostly small bursts. Will confirm top 10 by next update.

laura_comm: Draft should call out affected endpoint, region, and mitigation steps. Keep it concise and avoid technical blamestorm. I can polish.

maya_support: Posting update to statuspage draft channel now. Copy below (for approve):

maya_support: "We are investigating elevated error rates for the Text Generation API in our US-East region. Users may experience increased failures and timeouts when calling /v1/generate. Our engineers are actively rerouting traffic and applying mitigations. We will provide updates every 15 minutes until resolved."

laura_comm: Nice. Suggest small edit: change 'failures and timeouts' -> 'request failures and increased latency' and add 'no customer data loss' line.

maya_support: Updated draft: "We are investigating elevated request failures and increased latency for the Text Generation API in US‑East. Engineers are rerouting traffic and applying mitigations. No customer data loss is suspected. Updates every 15 minutes."

alex_sre: Mitigation in progress — reroute completed, throttles increased, prefix cache warmed on shared pool. Error rate dropped to ~6% in last 1m.

eric_oncall: Good. Keep monitoring. Ops, can you verify telemetry for retries/duplicate charges risk?

ops-scribe: Telemetry shows retry counts up but within automated backoff config. No billing-exception spikes yet, will alert if any anomalies.

jordan_infra: We also reverted a small hotfix that landed at 12:18 which seemed to increase conn churn. Revert completed at 12:30. Monitoring steady.

maya_support: Posting update to statuspage draft channel now. Copy below (for approve):

maya_support: "Update 12:35 UTC — We have applied traffic reroutes and reverted a recent routing change. Error rates have decreased but some requests may still fail or be slower than usual. Engineers continue to monitor. Estimated customer impact: ~40 customers affected, impact intermittent. Next update by 12:50 UTC."

laura_comm: Approved, small grammar fix sent inline.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Statuspage draft posted to /statuspage-drafts (link).

eric_oncall: I'll keep watch and will escalate if error rate rises >10% for 5m. If stable, plan publish 'resolved' notice once <1% for 10m.

alex_sre: Last check: 1m error rate 1.2%, 5m sliding 3.8%. Continuing to observe.

ops-scribe: Confirmed top-5 customers impacted (by failed requests): cust-alpha, cust-gamma, cust-delta, cust-zeta, cust-omega. Notifying CS leads for top-5.

maya_support: Sending targeted customer notes for top-5, and posting public update now.

laura_comm: Draft resolved copy ready. Keep it on standby: "Resolved — Issue with request failures in US‑East has been mitigated. A routing change and rollback restored normal service. We are monitoring to confirm full recovery. If you continue to see issues, please contact support."

alex_sre: Metrics show sustained <1% error for 12m now. Safe to publish resolved in 10m unless regression.

eric_oncall: Publishing resolved at 12:50 UTC.

incident-bot: :tada: STATUS UPDATE (12:50 UTC) — Resolved: Request failures in US‑East have been mitigated. Normal service restored; monitoring continues.

laura_comm: Posting final customer email and closing the thread. Great coordination everyone. :thumbsup:
